The UNSW Health Data Science Datathon is organised by the [Centre for Big Data Research in Health (CBDRH)](https://www.unsw.edu.au/research/cbdrh) from the Faculty of Medicine and Health. 

The CBDRH is Australia’s first research centre dedicated to health research using large-scale electronic data spanning the biomedical, clinical, health services and public health domains.

### Study with us

Our health data science programs are delivered by an interdisciplinary team of staff, who have world-leading expertise in managing, manipulating, analysing and visualising big data. Learn more about our post-graduate taught programs and research opportunities [here](https://www.unsw.edu.au/medicine-health/study-with-us/study-areas/health-data-science).
